notes.title: Patch Notes: 28th May 2020, Mytholmroyd
notes.notes:
Hello all,

This update adds new Player Vehicle Skins with which to look extra stylish while dealing death to your fellow road users. If you’ve unlocked a character that uses the corresponding vehicle then you can assign that skin regardless of whether you’ve completed their Season.

If you missed some of our previous updates, click the links below to see what’s been added since launch;

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/3557193237111858940/]Duffield[/url] (20th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026028761300/]Mugginton[/url] (22nd May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1653297026051157245/]Coxbench[/url] (28th May 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1642039362993277683/]Meenacladdy[/url] (7th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1643167006252949099/]Ballyhillin[/url] (25th June 2019)
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/]Suckley[/url] (11th November 2019)

[b]Improvements[/b]

- Added five new Player Vehicle Skins: True Fan (Interceptor Light), Omega (Civilian Vehicle), Go Fasta (T-Bird Thunder), Blocked (Interceptor Light), Hexed (Interceptor Medium).

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed typo: rogue apostrophe on Tutorial.
- Fixed typo: the Guided Rockets now fire in a “salvo”.

Want to swap strategies or share road war stories? Fancy a peek at what the studio is up to next? Head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/K6mTVpS]our Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.aurochdigital.com/]official website[/url].

Happy hunting!

notes.title: Our latest update is now live - plus competitions and podcasts!
notes.notes:
Hi there!
 
 [h1]Our latest update is now live! [/h1] 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/] The Suckley update [/url] focuses on improving visibility for achievement progress, introduces the ability to swap between vehicle skins, and brings with it bug fixes and some other minor improvements to the overall package. Read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1640927348828775113/] full patch notes here[/url], or the quick improvements summary below.
 
[b]Improvements[/b][list]
  [*]In-game achievements menu added. This handy update shows how close you are to reaching specific achievements. It’s accessible from the Main Menu and during combat when the game is paused.
  [*]Added the ability to swap between Normal and Pro paint scheme for character vehicles, once that character is completed.
  [*]Message box and Discord button added to Main Menu.
  [*]Moved version info about game to Options.
[/list]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/63a37284a8fed7f49c6c7366022c9ded376c1105.gif[/img]

 [h1]Photo Competition [/h1] 
Each month we run a photo competition using the in-game screenshot - you can find the  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1697221160915094957/]latest one here[/url]. This month the theme is Machine Guns - enter your photos and you could win 2 games and a Dark Future novel!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/370870/discussions/0/1697221160915094957/]Find out about this month's competition![/url]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26301211/6c363d7cc522edac43a889b6d6c4db90cdf557f8.gif[/img]

 [h1]Podcast [/h1] 
Want to know more behind the scenes from Dark Future: Blood Red states?
Listen to our podcast as we take you through the ins-and-outs of making a video game with episodes on the [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/the-dark-future-in-cardboard/]Dark Future board game[/url], [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/dark-future-the-video-game/]how we made Dark Future[/url], an [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/an-interview-with-james-swallow/]interview with James Swallow[/url], and the [url=https://aurochdigital.podbean.com/e/the-road-to-hell-a-history-of-car-combat/]History of Car Combat[/url].

Thank you again for all your great reviews here on Steam and spreading the word about the game with your friends - as a small studio, we really appreciate your support! And as always if you have any questions do let us know here on Steam, or over on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/K6mTVpS] our Discord[/url].

notes.title: Car combat game Dark Future has a release date and trailer
notes.notes:
Dark Future: Blood Red States is an adaptation of one of Games Workshop's non-Warhammer games, a post-apocalyptic game of Mad Max-style car combat. Auroch Digital's videogame version is due out on May 16 as they've announced with the trailer above.

As the video shows, a 'command mode' will let you slow down time to give orders to your car covered in missile launchers and mine-layers. It's set in the year 2023, because the original tabletop game was made in the 1980s, but you can insert your own jokes about its potential accuracy here.

Dark Future: Blood Red States will be available on Steam.
